acceptance_expectations.description: The report evaluates logistic regression accuracy >= baseline accuracy + 5 percentage points using measured comparison results and states whether the target is met, without requiring a favorable result.
Only attached data are used; external data and downloads are excluded, id is excluded from features, and preprocessing is learned only from training data.
Training uses train.csv and predictions.csv contains exactly id,label for all 600 test IDs in test order, without duplicates, with labels 0 or 1.
The report provides a conclusion and limitations, clearly identifies validation measurements and blind test predictions, and makes no invented test accuracy claim.
The documentation specifies the exact preprocessing, parameters and split used, including the seed if a seeded split is used.

constraints.text: Treat id as an opaque row identifier, not a feature.
predictions.csv must contain exactly id,label for all test IDs, in test order, without duplicates.
Learn preprocessing only from training data.
A seeded stratified train/validation split is permitted for the comparison because test labels are unavailable.
Distinguish validation measurements from blind test predictions; never invent test accuracy.
Document the exact preprocessing, parameters and split.

deliverables.description: Blind predictions for all 600 test.csv rows, with exactly id,label in test order, without duplicate IDs, and labels 0 or 1.
deliverables.name: predictions.csv

deliverables.description: Report the logistic regression and 1-nearest-neighbour accuracy comparison, whether the absolute 5 percentage point target is met, the conclusion and limitations, and the exact preprocessing, parameters and split. Distinguish validation results from blind test predictions.
deliverables.name: Comparison and limitations report

evidence_obligations.description: Provide the measured accuracies for logistic regression and the 1-nearest-neighbour baseline, their absolute difference in percentage points, the comparison context, and the resulting assessment of the >= 5 percentage point target.

Provide data provenance, the feature list showing id exclusion, and records identifying the training data used to learn preprocessing, sufficient to establish compliance with the attached-data-only restriction.
Provide predictions.csv, evidence that training used train.csv, and checks establishing exact columns, 600 rows, complete test-ID coverage, test order, no duplicate IDs, and labels in {0,1}.

Provide a report whose conclusion is supported by the recorded comparison results and whose limitations explicitly acknowledge unavailable test labels and distinguish validation accuracy from blind test predictions.
Provide the actual preprocessing configuration, model parameters and split details used, including any split seed, without substituting unspecified defaults for the recorded configuration.

in_scope.text: Compare logistic regression with a 1-nearest-neighbour baseline for the stated accuracy improvement.

mandatory_requirements.text: Test whether logistic regression accuracy is at least 5 percentage points above the 1-nearest-neighbour baseline accuracy. Report whether the target is met; achieving the improvement is not presumed.
Use only the attached data, with no external data or downloads; exclude id from features and learn preprocessing only from training data.
Train on train.csv and write predictions for test.csv to predictions.csv with exactly the columns id,label, covering all 600 test IDs in test order without duplicates and with labels in {0,1}.
Report the conclusion and limitations, distinguishing validation measurements from blind test predictions and never inventing test accuracy.
Document the exact preprocessing, parameters and split used.

objective.text: Test whether logistic regression beats a 1-nearest-neighbour baseline by at least 5 percentage points of accuracy, train on train.csv, produce test.csv predictions, and report the conclusion and limitations.

out_of_scope.text: External data and downloads are excluded.

target_metrics.metric: Accuracy difference between logistic regression and the 1-nearest-neighbour baseline
target_metrics.target_text: Test whether logistic regression exceeds the baseline by at least 5 percentage points of accuracy.
